mapper.select: SELECT id, object_id, record_id, detail_id, row_id, field_id, file_id, entry_id, space_id, file_name, file_size, mime_type, state, source_entry, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted FROM public.nocode_biz_attachment_binding WHERE object_id = #{objectId} AND record_id = #{recordId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_biz_attachment_binding SET state = 'HISTORY', updater = #{actor}, update_time = now() WHERE deleted = 0 AND state = 'ACTIVE' AND id IN #{id}
